verdict.rationale: Kino AI is a cloud-connected AI video editor that transcribes and describes user footage, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never mentions any training opt-out, data-use policy, or AI-training exclusion control. Local scrubbing and 'no account needed' are adjacent features and do not show that user data is kept out of model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
